title: Dmitry Vyukov — Go scheduler: Implementing language with lightweight concurrency
summary: Go runtime contributor Dmitry Vyukov looks inside the Go scheduler, explaining how goroutines and channels are implemented. He covers the main scheduler components and overall operation, then goes into details such as preemption and stacks.
why: Recommended as a good watch on how Go's M:N:P scheduler works and why it was designed that way compared with alternative schemes.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: This one notably also explains the design considerations for golangs M:N:P in comparison to other schemes
